_doc: The townspeople's Pokémon's bodies (creature_doduo.gd, creature_caterpie.gd). Doduo: duty = the part of a step cycle a foot is planted (walk / run), foot_w half the stance, ankle_h. Caterpie: step_w the part of a cycle a joint steps, delay between joints, settle (cycles/s to finish a wave), up_idle / up_crawl the front's lean (radians). Mr. Mime (creature_mrmime.gd): duty, foot width, ankle, stride (cyc_*), step heights, run_from / run_at speeds, bob, hip sway / chest counter, arm swing, tiptoe, fade (s between acts), mood_len (s per mood act); mrmime_jobs (mime_life.gd): each job's length dur [min, max] s. Their speeds are in native/life/companions.json.
